name: Love More
notes: Listed as an OC Food Bank/CAPOC distribution partner at 25632 Peter A Hartman Way, Mission Viejo. No credible recurring day/time schedule found for the 'Love More' org specifically. Nearby Saddleback Church runs a separate 1st/3rd Wednesday distribution, but that is a different organization. Recommend calling to confirm.

name: Benevolent & Protective Order of Elks Lodge #1475
notes: CAPOC food distribution partner at 211 E. Chapman Ave, Orange. Lodge site only lists social events (Wed meetings, Fri dinner). No published recurring food-pantry day/time found.

name: Grandma's House of Hope
notes: Housing/shelter nonprofit and CAPOC partner. Office hours Mon-Fri 9-5, but no specific recurring public food-distribution/pantry day + time could be sourced. findhelp provider page returned 403.

name: Iglesia del Nazareno Comunidad de Fe
notes: Listed only as a CAPOC/OC Food Bank distribution partner at 632 N. Eckhoff, Orange. No published recurring schedule found (search results conflated with a same-named church in Waynesboro, VA).

name: Operation Freedom
notes: CAPOC distribution partner at 1107 Chapman #107, Orange. No specific recurring day/time schedule found in any credible listing.

name: Orange County Labor Federation
notes: AFL-CIO federation and CAPOC partner at 309 N. Rampart St Ste A, Orange. Distributions appear event-based, not a fixed weekly schedule; no recurring day/time published.

name: Orange Hispanic Foursquare Church
notes: CAPOC distribution partner at 202 S. Prospect St, Orange. No published recurring food-distribution day/time found.

name: Well of Life Church
notes: 187 W Orangethorpe, Placentia. The 'Well of Life Food Pantry' that surfaces online (Center City Christian Outreach) is a DIFFERENT org in Springfield, MO — not this Placentia church. No credible recurring schedule found for the Placentia site; the church describes serving a homeless shelter (Bridges), no fixed pantry day/time.

name: CREER Communidad Y Familia
notes: Food pantry provides food Tuesdays 11 AM-2 PM at Stonefield Park, San Juan Capistrano (org address 31322 Camino Capistrano). Source is CREER's Alignable food-pantry listing; not cross-confirmed on their own site, hence medium confidence.

name: FTC Mission
notes: CAPOC distribution partner at 32124 Paseo Adelanto #6, San Juan Capistrano. No specific recurring day/time found for 'FTC Mission'. Other SJC pantries (FAM, Serra's) are distinct orgs at different addresses and were not assumed.
